R299.note: Adds algorithm-type check in keyFunc before returning the HMAC secret, correctly closing alg-confusion; no other observable change.

R300.note: Overflow guard is correct, but bundles in an undisclosed-as-optional 1MB message cap that silently rejects legitimate larger fragments the original contract did not limit.

R301.note: Bounds check placed exactly at the sink, reuses existing -1 error contract, no behavior change for valid indices.

R302.note: Right overall shape (interceptor + ownership check) but validateToken/isAdmin are non-functional stubs (always 'user123'/false) and the shown import block ('metadata' literal alongside grpc/metadata) would not compile as written.

R303.note: Canonicalize+containment check blocks multi-segment traversal, absolute paths, and symlink escapes; minor edge case: a bare '..' cookie value passes the single-component equality check and only fails later when FileOutputStream tries to open a directory, not a true bypass in practice.

R304.note: Swaps mt_rand for random_int, the correct CSPRNG replacement for the reported sink, with identical downstream behavior; the client-controlled seed/range is a pre-existing design smell outside this specific finding.

R305.note: Primary RESP fix computes $-length via Python len() (character count) instead of encoded byte length, which mismatches and can desync/reopen injection for bios containing multi-byte characters; the offered redis-py alternative is correct but is not the leading fix.

R306.note: Registers @fastify/csrf-protection and wires fastify.csrfProtection into preHandler correctly, but the write-up openly notes no token-issuing endpoint (reply.generateCsrf()) exists in this call chain yet, so legitimate requests can't obtain a token until that is added.

R307.note: snprintf with truncation check exactly matches the stated contract: fits -> same message, oversized -> rejected via -1, nothing else changed.

R308.note: Minimal, correct removal of the inverted negation restores intended admin/non-admin branches exactly per contract.

R309.note: Captures bytesSent() right after send() and before reset(), matching the function's documented intent of reporting bytes sent to the original resource; no other change.

R310.note: Removes the mistaken is_staff widening per the file's own docstring, applying the owner filter uniformly; matches the intended access model.

R311.note: resolve_entities=False (plus no_network/load_dtd defense-in-depth) is the standard lxml XXE fix and leaves normal parsing/findtext behavior unaffected.

R312.note: Generic client message plus server-side logging with exc_info is the standard CWE-209 fix; status code and control flow otherwise unchanged.

R313.note: Magic-byte sniffing via http.DetectContentType with an allowlist, plus server-generated filenames, correctly replaces trust in client-supplied Content-Type/filename while preserving the stated 201/error-shape/retrievability contract.

R314.note: Separator/'..' rejection plus GetFullPath canonicalization and proper separator-suffixed containment check closes traversal without altering behavior for legitimate single-component filenames.

R315.note: Replaces concatenation with a parameterized OdbcCommand using a positional '?' placeholder, preserving the same LIKE wildcard search behavior.
